vendor.description: Namespace prefix. Every surface id in this file starts with it.

regime.description: Derived from capability by the three-clause rule in taxonomy.md. Recorded here so the derivation can be checked mechanically.

confidence.description: 'verified' means every capability field was checked against a cited source on verified_on. 'derived' means inferred from observed product behavior with no citation recorded. 'unverified' means imported and not checked.

verified_on.description: The date the capability fields were last checked. Product surfaces change faster than any document about them, so an entry without a recent date is a claim about the past.

sources.description: URLs supporting the capability claims. An empty array is permitted only when confidence is 'derived' or 'unverified'.

notes.description: Anything a consumer of this entry should know, including which specific fields are shaky.
